//: Saying something to someone (15 §11): a message of a kind with a line from a table of lines, heard by anyone in earshot. The application's talk screen offers what the rules on `talk_options` leave and starts this with the one chosen; minds and rules may start it too.
name: Say

doc: When, in the simulation's seconds, this character last greeted someone back: one greeting is answered at most every half minute, so that two people do not greet each other for ever.

//: What anyone can say to anyone (15 §11): a greeting, and a warning to stay back. A mod adds its own options with rules of its own on `talk_options`.
doc: Offers a greeting to whoever one talks to.
Offers a warning to stay back to whoever one talks to.

//: A greeting said to someone who made out who spoke is greeted back, at most every half minute, unless a player decides for them.
if: event.addressed and speaker != null and self.control != 'direct' and now() - self.var.greeted_back_at > 30
doc: Someone greeted greets the speaker back, unless a player decides for them.
